title: The suit on the madrone
logline: Saturday. The suit, aired on a madrone branch behind the motel. It smells of damp mothballs. A deer looks at it. The strip's one landscape daily of the trip.

panels.composition: Behind the island motel: a madrone, red bark peeling, and hung from a branch on its hanger, the dark wool suit. Sunlight through it. A DEER at the edge of the trees, looking.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a dark wool suit hanging from the peeling red branch of a madrone tree behind a motel in bright light with a deer at the tree line looking at it, no words

panels.composition: The suit's shoulder. A moth hole, small, mended in 2009 with the wrong thread. The nine-dollar suit, five years on.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, close-up of a wool suit's shoulder with a small moth hole mended in slightly wrong-colored thread

panels.composition: WOOD in the motel doorway in a t-shirt, looking at the suit and the deer. Neither moves.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a thin man in a t-shirt standing in a motel doorway looking at a suit on a tree and a deer looking at the suit, no words

panels.composition: The deer gone. The suit turning slightly on its hanger. The madrone. The light. Held.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a wool suit turning slightly on its hanger in a madrone tree in bright island light, the deer gone, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The suit on the madrone. The deer. The mended hole.
